messages:
Maya: Quick design review — proposing a reorg of the sidebar clusters to group by workflow (ingest / serve / monitor) instead of product area. Sketch attached. Thoughts?

Oliver: Looks promising. Concern: deep links might break if we flatten groups. How are we handling canonical URL routing? e.g. `/console/models/:id/overview` vs `/console/models/overview/:id`

Maya: Good q. Proposal: keep canonical path as `/console/models/:id` and use a stable query param `?view=overview` for internal tabs. That preserves permalinks and avoids path churn.

Jamal: I prefer path segments for semantics (easier to bookmark). Query params can be noisy for keyboard focus restoration. Also some analytics rely on path-based grouping.

Sophie: Accessibility nit — when clusters collapse/expand the screen reader currently doesn't announce state. We need `aria-expanded` and a live region announce when the active cluster changes. @Design Bot can you run an audit?

Design Bot: /audit sidebar-group-aria -> Result: `aria-expanded` missing on `.cluster-toggle` in 3 places. Suggested fix: add `aria-controls` pointing to the panel id, ensure `aria-expanded` toggles, and include a `role="region"` with `aria-live="polite"` for announcements.

Maya: Copy tweak: breadcrumbs currently show "Models / 123" — propose "Models › ImageGen Model — v1.2" to give more context. Concern: overflow on mobile.

Oliver: Agree on richer breadcrumb. For truncation we should clamp at 40 chars and show full title in a tooltip on hover / long press. Mobile gets a collapsed form like "ImageGen v1.2".

Jamal: Also want to support deep-linking to subpanels with anchors, e.g., `/console/models/123?view=overview#section=inputs` so teams can link directly to input examples.

Sophie: For anchor handling, map the hash to scroll + set `history.replaceState` so we don't spam the history stack when we focus subpanels. That helps back-button behavior and screen-reader focus.

Maya: Action items: 1) Add aria attributes & live region (Jamal), 2) Implement canonical path + `?view=` mapping and anchor handling (Oliver), 3) Update breadcrumb copy and truncation rules + tooltips (Sophie). Meeting to sync Thu 10:00am. :calendar:

Oliver: I'll open a PR with the routing shim and migration notes. Will include examples of legacy -> canonical path redirects and tests. ETA: Tue EOD.

Jamal: I'll add the `aria-*` attrs, run `axe` and paste results in the thread. Will include a tiny test harness to exercise keyboard nav.

Sophie: I'll draft the breadcrumb copy guidelines and mobile truncation examples. Will propose tooltip copy and accessible labels.

Maya: Thanks all — attaching the quick mock and a short Loom: https://loom.com/share/abcdef123456 (timeboxed: 2m). :thumbsup:

Oliver: LGTM. Minor nit: ensure deep links preserve utm params for analytics.

Sophie: Noted. I'll add a note in the copy doc about preserving query params for campaign tracking.

Design Bot: Reminder scheduled: Thu 10:00am meeting created. Calendar invite sent to participants.
